git_wrapup_instructions.description: Returns a Git wrap-up protocol: an acceptance-criteria checklist the agent must satisfy before the session is considered shipped. Uses the operator's custom instructions if configured, otherwise emits a generic goals-strict/mechanism-generic default. Enriches the response with a repository snapshot (status, recent commits, recent tags) so the agent has immediate orientation for the commit and release steps.

acknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement to initiate the wrap-up workflow.

createTag.description: Controls whether the tag criterion appears in the emitted protocol. Omit or set `true` to include the tag step. Set `false` to omit it entirely — e.g., when tagging is deferred to a separate release step.
